verdict.rationale: Docusaurus is a static site generator that builds Markdown/MDX into static HTML. It holds no production data or live backend, so a sandbox-versus-production-data test environment is a category error for this kind of product. The local dev-server preview and the docusaurus.new browser playground are ways to preview a site or try the framework, not sandbox isolation from production data, so they do not make the axis apply.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data
